about: What Settings › AI starts with until the person sets their own (<config>/assist/settings.json). Presets are templates the person edits; nothing is probed or detected. An endpoint preset with an empty model takes the default model of assist.json. Keys are never in this file or the person's: they live in the system keychain under the endpoint's base URL.

sources.permissions: The founder's defaults for agents (docs/design/extension-abi-design.md): edits run inside the reviewable turn, which undoes as one step; files and publishing to a library ask; the view moves only when the person allows it. Publishing a part into the open project never asks (founder, 16 November). Each ask offers Allow once, Allow for this session, Always allow and Deny.
sources.limits: docs/assistant-panel.md §6.3: 40 model requests, 200 000 output tokens and 4 000 000 tokens a run as approved on 9 November; 45 minutes as approved in Q7 on 16 November. There are no per-turn caps on edits or calls (founder, 16 November).
sources.endpoint_presets: Anthropic's API base URL; Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint on its default port 11434 (the person changes it for LM Studio, llama-server or a hosted server). The context is a starting value the person corrects to what their server gives the model. Timeouts: 30 minutes for a hosted model; 90 for a local one, which at 17 tokens a second takes 31 minutes for 32 000 output tokens.
sources.agent_presets: The ACP launch commands each agent documents: claude-agent-acp, codex-acp, gemini --acp, opencode acp.
